$comment: Intake station: every supply request gathered from email, chat, forms, etc., deposited into a structured catalog for the shopping cycle.
title: ShoppingRequestsResult

requests.$comment: One entry per distinct request. Empty is allowed; the workflow short-circuits later if nothing arrived.

items.$comment: A single inbound request, re-posited with a stable id and source locator.

id.$comment: Stable id for this cycle, e.g. req-001.

channel.$comment: How the request arrived: email, chat, form, voice-note, other.

summary.$comment: One-line restatement of what they want.

body.$comment: Full request text as received (or cleaned transcript).

source.$comment: Where to re-open the original: mailbox path, chat permalink, file path, etc.

received_at.$comment: Optional ISO-ish timestamp when the request arrived.

notes.$comment: Intake narrative: coverage, noise skipped, open questions.
